header.name: Sociology of India: Themes and Perspectives
header.description: This course will equip students with an understanding of the foundations, contemporary debates and relevant themes of Sociology and Social Anthropology in India. It seeks to familiarise students with the discipline as a pre-requirement to doing research in Sociology/Social Anthropology. With this main objective in mind, the course is broadly divided in two parts: the first part engages with the debatessurrounding, theory, approaches, methods, contextualisation, refexivity and so on in Sociology. The second part, introduces key themes in Sociology and Social Anthropology. By the end of the course, the students will be able to develop agrounding in Sociology and use it to envision their own research.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: To identify various Sociological Concepts, Themes and Traditions

outcomes.label: CO3

outcomes.label: CO5
